records.subject: Welcome aboard, Granite Partners
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, 8 days left, zero product progress (no project, no invite, no milestone). Customer has never replied to five outbound emails (email:b8f91232, email:1148f1b9, email:188061ba); only engagement is a feature ask and an open duplicate-charge ticket, which likely blocks adoption until resolved.

draft.subject: Your billing ticket and a first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for flagging the duplicate charge - your ticket is open and the team is reviewing it, and they'll reply in that thread. On the weekly summary email: it isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap, and I've noted your interest.

Separately, I'd like to get Granite Partners moving in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is the useful starting point.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
